phone.title: Phone health readings
phone.intro: Rinda can read the health data your phone already keeps in Apple Health or Health Connect, such as heart rate, steps, sleep, blood pressure and weight. Only one summary per day is sent, and you can stop at any time.
phone.share: Share my phone's health readings with Rinda
phone.onlyApp: This works in the Rinda phone app, where your phone lets Rinda read its health data.
phone.failed: Rinda could not read your phone's health data. Check that Health Connect (Android) or Apple Health (iPhone) allows Rinda to read it.
phone.iosNote: On iPhone, Apple does not tell apps which readings you allowed, so a missing reading may mean it was not shared.
phone.off: Phone health readings are not switched on yet.
phone.filled: Filled from your phone. Check the numbers before you continue.
phone.noRecent: No recent readings from your phone.

sms.title: Text messages (SMS)
sms.body: Get a text message after each check-up with your results and numbers, tips and a link to the full report. Mood and stress results are never sent. Anyone who can open your phone can read it.
sms.needPhone: Add your phone number in "My details" above to get these.
sms.unavailable: Text messages are not switched on yet.
